usage_rules.colors: ONLY use tokens from --rj-* CSS variables. Semantic reds (#991b1b on #fee2e2) allowed for negative-state indicators. NEVER introduce purple/pink/teal/orange/lime/indigo.
usage_rules.typography: Space Grotesk for headings and mono, Inter for body. Never Arial, Roboto, system-ui as primary.
usage_rules.logo: Always use the GCS URL. Never re-generate or crop.
usage_rules.layout: Assume 1280px design width for docs, mobile-first for forms.
usage_rules.voice: Straight-shooting · builder-brained · premium · execution-ready. No hype without infrastructure.
usage_rules.when_building_new: Always import assets/brand.css. Always follow the closest existing asset in the same category as a pattern. NEVER invent a new color palette.

decision_tree.user_wants_lead_form: Use category=forms. Pick specific form based on lead type: credit → credit-qualify · funding → funding-qualify · unknown → universal-funnel · partner → partnership-application · media → podcast-guest.
